_about: FMC 10.0.1 (build 1), Global/mcp-test-leaf, 2026-10-21 (W6N live-A, F76 #171): Logging settings of a child access policy (mcp-w6-child-acp, ...055837) made with POST + PUT inheritancesettings, base mcp-w6-acp (...963108). links dropped.

first_deploy_error._source: fmc_deploy(devices=[mcp-ftd1]) after assigning the child: FMC's 400 (nothing deployed)
first_deploy_error.description: Errors or warnings present in Device committed policies: | Access Control Policy Logging configuration is invalid. Access Control rules inherited from base policy 'mcp-w6-acp' have syslog configured to use Logging configuration. Configure a valid syslog destination to avoid syslogs not being sent.

child_loggingsettings._source: GET policy/accesspolicies/<child>/loggingsettings?expanded=true after the base was set (FMC's defaults: its own, no syslog destination)

inherit_put._source: PUT policy/accesspolicies/<child>/loggingsettings/<its id> with inheritFromParent true: FMC answers with the BASE's setting (its id, metadata.inheritedPolicy); the deployment then passed

child_loggingsettings_base_cleared._source: GET .../loggingsettings after PUT inheritancesettings without basePolicy: the child's own setting is back
